page.body:
Updating account/profile information

Estimated reading: 1 minute 620 views

Keeping your account information up-to-date is essential for ensuring that you have access to all of the features and benefits of PropertyList. It also helps to ensure that your contact information is accurate and that you receive important notifications from the platform.

Edit Contact Info

Here you can change your user password, platform language and notifications.
Log in to your PropertyList.es account and click on your USER NAME on the top right.

  • Click “My Settings”

To edit a staff members account:
Log in to your PropertyList.es account and click on the “STAFF” tab on the left.

  • Select a staff member
  • Click edit
  • Here you can edit: name, phone, email, platform language and user permissions.
